revision_reason: Add four Weber families whose scoreable flow is still live. The five originally declared Weber families' text-bearing reviews fell from 7,964 in 2020 to 421 in 2025, thinning the peer control in exactly the recent window the comparison needs. Additions carry newest reviews 0-1 days old at 33-41% text. Sixteen brand-route products compared pairwise: zero overlapping pairs. No tone has been scored for this group.
substitutability_test: Would a consumer shopping for this seed's product consider this company's product instead of it, as a direct alternative for the same need, at the same point of purchase? If yes, it is a peer. Size, country, listing venue and currency are irrelevant to the answer.
